text.en: This Act may be cited as the Burial Grounds Act.

(1) No place shall, save as hereinafter in this section No place to provided, be used for the interment or cremation of any be used for or under a licence from His Majesty the Sultan cremation Pertuan in Council who shall'have power at his except by discretion from time to time to grant or refuse such licences and to impose such conditions as he may think fit.

(2) The Minister may for special reasons in any particular case by writing under his hand authorise the interment of the corpse of any person in such writing named in or place, whether licensed or not under subsecunder such conditions as he thinks necessary for the of the public health and upon payment of such fee not exceeding $50 as he may consider reasonable in each case.

heading.en: Power to close burial grounds, and revoke licences

text.en: His Majesty in Council may at any time on being that any burial ground or place of cremation cannot li-be further used without danger to the public health or comfort, or that the same being licensed is being used in conof the terms or conditions of the licence, order to be closed or may revoke the licence.

PROVISIONS

heading.en: Sanction of Attorney General required to prosecute

text.en: No prosecution shall be instituted under section 8 or Sanction of 11 of this Act without the previous sanction in writ-Attorney ing of the Attorney General or of an officer to whom the quired to proof granting such sanction shall have been delegated secute -by him.

The Minister may delegate any of the powers confer-Delegation of red upon him by this Act, other than the power of granting powers B.L.R.O. 111984 licences for the exhumation of corpses, to a Municipal Board to be exercised within the area subject to its control under such conditions as he may think fit.
